visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair and a white knit dress sits at a government service desk, holding a folder and looking slightly stressed but happy. (2) At home, she is seen drying her hair with a hairdryer, then picking up a white and blue patterned mug from a shelf. She is wearing a black silk slip dress. (3) She prepares for the day, hanging up her white wedding outfit, eating breakfast prepared by her mother, and applying skincare and makeup. Her mother wears pink pajamas. (4) In a closet, she puts on pearl earrings and changes into the white knit dress with large black buttons. She sprays perfume and dances with excitement. (5) Inside a car, raindrops are visible on the window. The car's infotainment screen shows the song 'Marry Me Today'. She and a man hold hands. (6) She walks outside under an umbrella, holding a blue folder. Her mother follows, wearing a pink lace dress and smiling at the camera. (7) At the registration office, a bald man in a white shirt (the groom) enters with a bouquet. The woman shows the marriage certificate. (8) A group of friends/witnesses gather around them. The woman realizes her bag is missing, and the man runs out to find it. (9) They sit together at the counter, signing documents while friends take photos and videos with professional cameras and phones. (10) They celebrate with high-fives and poses, including heart gestures. They show their new ID cards to the camera. (11) The group heads to a Din Tai Fung restaurant, where they share a meal of xiaolongbao and toast with tea. (12) The video ends with a shot of the woman eating a dumpling and a black screen with 'THE END'.
